create_deterministic_splitter: create a DeterministicSplitter with train/val/test ratios to assign UIDs to split buckets
use_splitter_call: use the DeterministicSplitter call method to assign a unique ID to a deterministic split bucket
validate_splitter_ratios: validate that DeterministicSplitter ratios are positive and sum to one using post init
chunk_sound_events: chunk Sound events in a pandas DataFrame into smaller segments by max duration
chunk_video_events_by_type: chunk Video events aligned to sections of a specific event type in a DataFrame
